title: fix(cloud-connection): install-local keeps and honours the landed-key record, so a seed row a tenant deleted stays deleted
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
Fixes #34405

Clause-②: no (the door starts honouring the loader's existing `landedKeys` guard, #31021; no accepted shape or public export widens; the dev confirms)
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6929076086 (#34405, A 「A 重启也不补回」: the install-local restart heal honours the landed-key record)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:install-local 的样例数据灌入(安装、升级、重启自愈、新组织回放、非托管副本首灌)现在会记录并遵守「哪些样例行已落地」的台账 `sys_seed_landed_key`;租户删掉的样例行,重装、升级、重启后不再自己冒回来。「重新灌入样例数据」按钮仍会把缺的行全部补回。
- **为什么改**:租户管理员删掉一条演示客户或演示订单,下次重装或升级又出现,像是删除没生效。平台自身的启动灌入早已遵守这个台账,只有 install-local 这个入口没接上。
- **风险与回滚**:重装或升级后,被删的样例行不再回来,只能用「重新灌入」找回(本卡要的行为)。重启自愈也遵守台账(维护者裁决 A「A 重启也不补回」,记录 6929076086):单租户重启不再补回被人删掉的样例行;样例行被人删光、或被「清除样例数据」清掉后再重装,重启都不补回;只有库里连台账一起丢了(新库)才整套补回。这类「全被台账扣下」的重启,启动横幅、/ready 与 os verify 读作正常(settled),不再报「已安装但 0 行」。#30324 的重启用例只改了两次启动之间的准备步骤(同时清掉台账),归属断言一字未改(裁定 6670861426 只管归属)。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `runInlineSeed` 及其四个调用点(各入口选的模式);`marketplace-install-local-landed-keys.test.ts`;`packages/cli/test/package-install-local-sample-owner.integration.test.ts` 两次启动之间新增的清台账步骤。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-landed-keys.test.ts`,预期 15 个用例全绿(原 13 个在 main 上实测全红;新增的「清除、重装、重启后仍为空」用例在 main 上未测)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin.runInlineSeed` built `SeedLoaderService` without the `landedKeys` option, so install-local neither read nor wrote `sys_seed_landed_key` and the loader's guard (#31021) never applied on this door. `runInlineSeed` now takes the mode as a required parameter and hands it to the loader; every caller names one, none is defaulted.

What the loader's two modes do (`SeedLoaderServiceOptions.landedKeys`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`):

- `'honour'`: every keyed row an `upsert` or `ignore` dataset lands (inserted, updated, or matched and left alone) is recorded under the organization the load seeds; a recorded key whose row is now gone is not inserted again (a person removed it), and a reference to such a row is left as it is instead of reported unresolved. A key never recorded still lands, so a row an upgrade adds to the seed is inserted. A withheld row is counted in `skipped`.
- `'reseed'`: records the same, and inserts every missing row whatever the record says.
- Either mode keeps no record on a load that seeds no organization (said once at `info`) or in a composition that does not register `sys_seed_landed_key` (said once at `warn`).

Per door:

| Door | Mode |
|---|---|
| Install and upgrade (`applySideEffects`, the caller's active organization under a wall, else the sole organization) | `honour` |
| Restart heal of an empty database | `honour` |
| Per-organization replayer this door registers | `honour`; `{ reseed: true }` gives `reseed`, as the AppPlugin replayer does |
| Unmanaged copy, first load | `honour` |
| Sample-data reseed (ledgered package and unmanaged copy) | `reseed` |

No answer shape changes: the install's `seeded` summary and the reseed's `{ manifestId, inserted, updated, skipped, errors, withSampleData }` keep their fields. No replay into other existing organizations on upgrade (decision card #34406, not built).

Prose that this change made false is corrected in the same PR: the `mode` JSDoc and `.describe()` in `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` (and the four generated reference pages), `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`, and the `sys_seed_landed_key` object's JSDoc in `@objectstack/platform-objects` said a package install or upgrade, its heal, its reseed and the marketplace's fallback `seed-replayer` keep no record. They now say a seed publish is the load that keeps none. This restates the card's route (route B on #34336, ruling-ref 6919107678); no contract shape changes. The seat kept this prose in this PR (17:24Z), and the claim's file surface is amended on #34405 to match the diff.

## Tests

New `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-landed-keys.test.ts`: the real `SeedLoaderService` (`@objectstack/runtime`) over a faithful in-memory engine that registers `sys_seed_landed_key`, each case run on a flat bundle and on a composed one (`packages[]`, the datasets in the package bodies):

- install writes `sys_seed_landed_key` for every row it lands, in the organization it seeds;
- a seed row deleted after the install stays deleted across a reinstall and an upgrade; the row the upgrade adds lands;
- under the organization wall (`isolated`), the install and the upgrade keep it in the caller's active organization, and none in another;
- the reseed inserts every missing row, answers `{ inserted: 2, skipped: 2 }`, records each key once, and the record still stands for the next removal;
- a restart does not heal back seed rows a person deleted, and still heals a new database whole;
- the per-organization replayer honours the record per organization, and `{ reseed: true }` brings a removed row back;
- an unmanaged copy: a second install load leaves a deleted row out, the reseed brings it back.

- At `1f3516d7e8` (the fix): `Tests 13 passed (13)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 85 passed (85)`, `Tests 1251 passed (1251)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection typecheck` (both programs; the new test is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s file list) exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **The restart heal is wired to `honour`, a door the card does not name (ruled A by the maintainer, 6929076086).** The heal runs only when every seeded object is empty and the ledger does not record a purge, and then withholds every key the database records. Pinned in `marketplace-install-local-landed-keys.test.ts` (flat and composed): a restart over a seed a person emptied (no purge) does not heal it back; a purge followed by a reinstall and a restart stays purged (the reinstall clears `sampleDataPurged`, so the heal's `honour` is what holds it; measured by ablation); a new database (no rows, no record) is healed whole. A heal that withholds every row reports a settled seed (real `skipped`, `info`, no `emptyInstall`), so the boot banner, `objectstack:seed-settled`, `GET /ready` and `os verify` read it as settled (fix round 3). #30324's restart case now reaches its heal through that last state: between its boots it also clears `sys_seed_landed_key`, and its ownership assertions are unchanged (ruling 6670861426 decides who owns the healed rows, not whether a restart refills rows a person deleted).
- **A purge followed by a reinstall or upgrade no longer brings the sample rows back**; the sample-data reseed does. That is the card's rule applied to a purge (the purge deletes the rows through the engine, so their keys stay recorded). The listing's `withSampleData` reads the rows, not the ledger, so it answers `false` there.
- An existing install records nothing until its next install, upgrade, reseed, replay or restart heal, so a row a person deletes before that load, even after the upgrade, comes back on it once, and stays deleted from then on (the record starts empty).
- The loader's `info` line for withheld rows now names an installed package's sample-data reseed beside `seed-replayer` with `{ reseed: true }` as the way back (fix round 3, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch).
- Boundary: a heal over datasets that are all `mode: 'update'` on an empty database lands nothing and counts every row in `skipped` (update writes matched rows only). It now reads as settled, not as an empty install, because the summary does not tell an update skip from a withheld row. Telling them apart needs a withheld count in the loader's summary (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`), which is not in this PR.
- Observation, not filed: `runInlineSeed` also builds the loader without `getFieldFiles`, so a seed row naming a seed file is refused on this door. Not reproduced here.

## Fix round 1

No code change this round; the head stays `2297ac0d`. Test Core (8/8) is red on one case: `#30324 … a restart over emptied tables heals them, owned by the installer the ledger records` (`expected [] to deeply equal [ 'Sample Deal A', …(2) ]`), reproduced locally.

That pin and this PR's restart pin (`a restart does not heal back the seed rows a person deleted…`) assert opposite outcomes for the same scenario: the same database, every seeded row deleted by a person (not purged), then a restart. One argument decides between them, measured: with `landedKeys` removed from the restart heal, this PR's pin goes red 2/13 and #30324 green 6/6; at head the reverse. No shape keeps both: there is no deletion record to tell the two apart. The choice is open on the card (report 6924505372): A keep `honour` and move #30324's restart trigger to a database that has also lost its landed-key record (assertions verbatim), or B revert the heal to the pre-PR behaviour.

`git merge-tree` against #34316 and #34428: no conflict, and neither touches `runInlineSeed`.

## Fix round 5

Answers the merge-queue red of run 43958493299 (`Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)`, job 133619628264): in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/install-local-no-active-organization.dogfood.test.ts` the control case expected the reinstall after a purge in organization B to land the 28 sample rows again; with this PR it lands 0. Test-only change; no product code moved. Head `e738de9f43`.

- **Why it is honour, not a defect.** The purge does not touch `sys_seed_landed_key`: `purgeSeedRows` (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-purge.ts:359-380`) only calls `engine.delete` on the seeded objects, and the purge handler (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` around 6485-6503) only adds a ledger flag. No code path deletes a `sys_seed_landed_key` row (the loader only reads and inserts it, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts:4758`, `:4830`). B's record survives the purge, so the reinstall withholds every recorded key: the card's rule, with ruling 6929076086 on the restart side.
- **The change.** The control now expects the reinstall to report `{ mode: 'inline', inserted: 0, skipped: 28, errors: 0 }` with B holding 0 rows. A reseed after the reinstall proves the way back: `200 { inserted: 28, errors: 0, withSampleData: true }`, B holds 28, A still holds 0. The header and test name say so, and a one-line comment cites #34405 and 6929076086. Every other assertion is unchanged.
